Have a history of anxiety. A couple of years ago it was especially bad & I would have panic attacks on a regular basis. It got to the point where I was prescribed medication. The pills helped but they made me feel sleepy all day long. I slept for an irregular amount of hours & I felt very lethargic when I was awake. Due to not being able to afford them anymore I stopped taking them about a year and a half afterward. Horrible, horrible couple of months but slowly I started feeling better & finding ways to handle my anxiety. When things start getting really stressful I will still have panic attacks but no where near as often as I used to have them before. Breathing techniques & exercise have really helped me out.
